evidence.notes: Database.insert evaluates a metadata text default formula before storing the field value.

source.content: @isTest private class TextFormulaDefaultDmlTest { @isTest static void textDefaultFormulaEvaluatesOnInsert() { Database.SaveResult result = Database.insert(new Account(Name = 'Acme'), false); System.assertEquals(true, result.isSuccess()); Account stored = [SELECT DefaultedLabel__c FROM Account WHERE Id = :result.getId()]; System.assertNotEquals('TEXT(TODAY())', stored.DefaultedLabel__c); System.assertEquals(String.valueOf(Date.today()), stored.DefaultedLabel__c); } }
